caps.effective_cap_rule: for every cap: min(policy, lender_override, official) ignoring nulls; for min gap: max(policy, lender_override, official)
caps.note: With a 120-minute same-channel gap inside 08:00-19:00 (end exclusive), at most 6 sends per channel per day are physically possible. B3=9 and B4=12 are stored as configured but bind at 6 under the current window. Lender overrides may tighten any cap, including adding weekly caps, which policy itself does not set.

lender_overrides.description: Optional caps supplied by the lender per allocation. Can only tighten policy, never loosen it. null = lender sets no limit for that item.

stop_for_day_triggers.rule: ivr or voicebot call answered for more than 10 seconds
any reply or borrower behaviour disposition captured on any channel

stop_for_day_effect: no further outbound on any channel until next contact day

PROMISE_TO_PAY.effect: no outbound activity on any channel until the PTP date
PROMISE_TO_PAY.on_ptp_date: check verified payment before any outreach
PROMISE_TO_PAY.if_paid: close obligation; cancel queued touches for that obligation
PROMISE_TO_PAY.if_unpaid_by_end_of_ptp_date: tag BROKEN_PTP; resume next contact day at band caps

HARDSHIP.trigger: borrower reports hardship (accident, illness, job loss, similar)
HARDSHIP.if_borrower_gives_date_within_4_days: hold until that date and time, then resume
HARDSHIP.if_borrower_gives_date_beyond_4_days: keep hold and flag to supervisor (HANDOFF)

STOP_OPT_OUT.trigger: STOP or opt-out on any channel
STOP_OPT_OUT.effect: suppress ALL channels from the next decision cycle; cancel pending queued sends
STOP_OPT_OUT.re_entry: borrower can opt back in per channel; consent version recorded

counts_as_reply: call answered with a captured response

budget.campaign_pool_inr: budget_per_case_inr * count(budgeted loans) - a case is one loan account; the budgeted set is explicitly selected at intake (see K24 budget_scope)
budget.per_case_spend: flexible; individual cases may spend below or above budget_per_case
budget.daily_pacing: remaining_pool / remaining_contact_days, recomputed each contact day; unspent carries forward
budget.stop_conditions: pool exhausted OR collection target achieved (whichever first) - applies in ALL runs including the official simulator run (decided by Ojas, 19 Nov; accepted risk: may shorten the judged comparison window)

amount_pct.definition: verified INR collected in period / INR overdue at allocation start

count_pct.definition: accounts fully cured in period / accounts allocated
